answer: Courier credit on the salt road is earned one lamp at a time. A rider posts 43 POA against a single dune lamp and stays with it all night. An inspector who must wander in from a different well brings a sealed opal chip that seats only in that lamp's socket; the rider has 24 seconds to lock the chip and sign the socket heat. Later depots honor a waybill only if the same key still holds the lamp and a second chip seats true. A late lock, borrowed socket, or two keys on one lamp slashes the 43 POA and benches it 13 epochs. 170 aliases need 170 lamps and 7310 POA; an honest rider posts one lamp.
